reviews.text: Based on Google reviews, I booked a trim for my Pomeranian dog. Unfortunately, the pom had been clipped with a machine. And unfortunately, the tail had apparently been clipped with a machine so that it had been clipped straight down the middle of the tail too short so that a piece was missing in the middle. A pom's tail should be like a whisp. At least I don't recommend going with a pom. And the mark is untidy when it has been clipped with a clipper, which I can't do to poms

We've been there a couple of times already, and we won't be going anywhere else 🐶💛 Always dog-oriented service, you can stay and watch the grooming, and the first time we stayed with our rescue dog. There are no other dogs there, which is a big relief. We've been to Veera for grooming. …

We went a few times with the puppy to practice free grooming and we were both very satisfied. It's a real shame that we can't continue our visits to Kultaturri as the distance is too long without a car. I warmly recommend it to everyone 🤎 thank you for the times we managed to go, you do valuable work and I hope that we will return to practice when the car situation changes.
Always such a happy and well-groomed dog heading home from Kultaturri. :)

The best! The little one starts wagging his tail even before he is brought inside. The dog enjoys it and the owner is happy not to have to fight with his nails at home. The prices are reasonable and the professionalism is on point. I can only recommend it.

The best grooming salon, I wouldn't take my dog ​​anywhere else. The dog is treated gently and given breaks during the grooming. The grooming is done on the dog's terms and my dog ​​always leaves the grooming happy <3 Fransi also gives good advice on coat and dog care.
Finally found a grooming salon that truly takes the dog into consideration 😍 Grooming is truly done on the dog's terms. Expert and professional service! …
Reliable and professional grooming work with the dog's physical and mental well-being first. Highly recommended.

Expert and warm service for both dogs and owners. I have been using Kultaturri and Frans' grooming services for my Havapoo dog since he was less than a year old and his feedback is certainly the same as mine because you can't pass the shop or Frans without a happy tail wagging 😍 …

It's pathetic that you're sharing false information about the grooming industry, promoting yourself. If you post a factual comment, you'll get blocked for it. Avian is too new to the industry to criticize other groomers and the working methods and professionalism of others. Even if others don't crawl on the floor, it doesn't mean that this is the only gentle groomer in Finland. Too bad.
A truly dog-oriented groomer who strives to make the experience good for the dog. Both I and the dog were satisfied with the service, who received treats throughout the grooming ☺️
Eddie the poodle loves visiting Kultaturri, even though grooming and fur care aren't exactly his favorite things to do!
The best grooming salon in the world! Completely dog-friendly and friendly service❤️
Grooming is specifically about the dog's well-being.
A shy dog ​​who was nervous about the grooming got a great result and didn't want to leave 😂❤️ Thanks for the good work ❤️ …
